reviews.zh: 呢啲面膜超級保濕，我最鍾意嘅係入面有好多塊，所以有好多剩。我好鍾意個味道，超級放鬆，我唔識點形容，聞落好似迷迭香咁，我自己都唔知係咪，但真係好正，用完塊面靚到不得了。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Carrot Carotene Daily Mask Sheet 30P
reviews.text: The SKINFOOD Carrot Carotene Daily Mask Sheet is a nourishing and soothing sheet mask that delivers a good dose of hydration and comfort, especially for dry or fatigued skin. Infused with carrot extract rich in beta-carotene and antioxidants, it helps support a healthier-looking complexion while calming and replenishing skin after daily stressors. The mask adheres well and the essence absorbs quickly without a greasy feel, leaving skin soft, smooth, and lightly refreshed. It’s a gentle, everyday pick for boosting moisture and giving your skin a subtle glow.
reviews.zh: SKINFOOD Carrot Carotene Daily Mask Sheet 係一款滋養舒緩嘅片裝面膜，特別適合乾燥或疲憊肌膚，提供充足嘅保濕同舒適感。蘊含豐富 β-胡蘿蔔素同抗氧化成分嘅胡蘿蔔萃取，有助支持更健康嘅膚色，同時舒緩和補充受日常壓力影響嘅肌膚。面膜貼服度好，精華吸收快速而且唔油笠，用完皮膚變得柔軟、滑溜、輕爽。溫和嘅日常之選，可以提升保濕同俾皮膚淡淡光澤。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Carrot Carotene Daily Mask Sheet 30P
reviews.text: I love these masks. It’s the third time I’m purchasing these. I use them as a lightweight morning sheet mask.

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Carrot Carotene Daily Mask Sheet 30P
reviews.text: I love the toner pad so I try this one and it works great also. I love using it when my skin get sensitive during that time or when I got break out. It does help calm my skin down. For sure is a repurchase
reviews.zh: 我鍾意爽膚水棉片，所以試咗呢款，一樣好好用。每當皮膚變得敏感或者爆瘡嘅時候，我就會用佢。佢真係幫到我舒緩皮膚。一定會回購。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Carrot Carotene Daily Mask Sheet 30P
reviews.text: Love this sheet mask! It’s super moisturizing and easy to apply and use. Feels really gentle and friendly on my sensitive skin—no irritation at all. I like to use it while drying my hair after a shower, and it keeps my skin perfectly hydrated and refreshed by the time I’m done. It also helps improve my skin texture, leaving it soft, smooth, and healthy-looking.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款片裝面膜！超級保濕，而且容易敷上。對我嘅敏感肌嚟講感覺好溫和——完全無刺激。我鍾意沖完涼之後吹頭嗰陣敷住，到吹完頭皮膚就剛剛好夠水潤又清爽。仲有助改善膚質，用完皮膚變得柔軟、滑溜、睇落更健康。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Carrot Carotene Daily Mask Sheet 30P
reviews.text: Very convenient to use! It comes with a plastic tweezer (see pic) so, you can easily pick up the mask without putting your hands in the container, very hygienic! It's not as moisturizing as individually packed facemasks (better soaked in liquid) but, it's good enough for a 5-10min use while I dry my hair or just before applying makeup. There's a shallow puddle of more liquid on the bottom of the container, so I try to fish out the mask from the bottom instead of the top to get more moisture.
reviews.zh: 用起上嚟好方便！附送一支膠鑷（見圖），唔使將手伸入樽度就夾得到面膜，好衛生！保濕度就冇單片獨立包裝嗰啲咁好（嗰啲浸得透啲），但用嚟敷五至十分鐘、趁吹頭或者化妝前用就夠。樽底會有一小灘多出嚟嘅液體

reviews.text: 正直がっかりです。。スキンフードの一枚いりのパックが大好きなのでとても期待していましたがペラペラでカサカサです。毎回パックの塊を天地返しして液を吸い込ませています。。もう買いません。同じラインの化粧水を一本染み込ませると良いです。
reviews.zh: 老實講好失望。。我好鍾意 SKINFOOD 單片裝嗰款面膜，所以好期待，但呢啲又薄又乾。每次都要將成疊面膜上下反轉，等佢哋吸返啲液體。。唔會再買。加一支同系列嘅化妝水浸落去會好啲。
